text:
marta: Anyone else seeing EBS snapshot errors in us-west-2? A training rollout hit a hard wall and dozens of attach ops timed out.

liam: Yep — saw lots of `RequestLimitExceeded` and `CreateSnapshot` failures around 03:14 UTC. We had ~120 workers checkpointing concurrently; attach latency jumped from ~800ms to 12s.

sasha: Our job logs show 429s for the snapshots API and some throttled DescribeVolumes calls too.

marta: We should file quota increases for both volume throughput and snapshots-per-second, but also do quick mitigations so deploys don't grind to a halt.

ryan: I'll open the AWS support case for account 987654321. Target asks:
- bump gp3 aggregate throughput in us-west-2 to 6000 MB/s
- increase snapshot concurrency (API QPS) to 400
- raise max volumes per region if needed
I'll include our peak concurrency graphs and the business impact.

cloud-ops-bot: Support case created: SR-02479901 (by ryan). Expected initial response 24h. Linked INFRA ticket INFRA-4239.

devex: For the description, call out: nightly model checkpoints (3x/day), average volume size ~600GB, replication to GCS for DR, and revenue impact: training window slipping affecting customer-facing retrains.

oncall-gcp: Noted similar issues for cross-region snapshot copies to GCS. Requests for higher transfer QPS and temporary ingress egress bump submitted: Case 1234600011. GCP asked for byte/sec and op/sec charts (I've attached last 48h).

marta: Immediate mitigations we can deploy in the next hour:
- add random jitter to checkpoint cron across pods (0-900s)
- stagger rolling updates so only a portion of workers snapshot at once
- enable compression and chunked uploads to GCS instead of EBS snapshots for long checkpoints
- cleanup orphan/deleted-instance snapshots (we have ~300 old snapshots)
- consider using instance-store (ephemeral) for non-critical preemptible runs

liam: Found a backup job that runs on every node: `kubectl exec backup-daemon -- ./snapshot.sh --force` 00 we should remove `--force` and make it respect `CHECKPOINT_TYPE=incremental`.

sasha: I'll run a quick pruning job to delete completed job snapshots older than 30 days and tag snapshots by cluster so we can bulk-delete next week. Expect to free ~1.2k snapshots.

ryan: AWS SR link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/?displayId=SR-02479901. I asked for an interim throttle increase and included a request to expedite because of production impact.

devex: I'll draft a short cost estimate: reserved gp3 throughput to reach 6GB/s ~ $2.5k/month; snapshot API increase is free but may require TAM intervention.

oncall-gcp: GCP case: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/1234600011. Support asked for operation per second numbers; I've attached our Grafana panels.

marta: Action items:
- ryan: follow up AWS SR every 12h, escalate to TAM if no reply in 36h
- oncall-gcp: request temp quota bump for cross-region transfers and provide op/sec charts
- liam: patch backup job to remove forced full snapshots and add guardrail env var
- sasha: run snapshot pruning and post counts here
- devex: produce cost/impact blurb for infra approvers

cloud-ops-bot: INFRA-4239 updated: linked SR-02479901 and GCP 1234600011. Assigned to storage-owner oncall.

marta: Let's aim for containment in 48-72h. If you make any changes to snapshot cadence, drop the logs here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
